We need to propose a retrosynthesis route for target SMILES: COc1cccc(NC(=O)c2nnn(Cc3ccc(CN4CC(F)C4)cc3)c2N)c1.

We must use templates 1914393, 1914394, 1914395 in this order. So first apply template 1914393 to break target into precursors, then apply 1914394 to one of the precursors, then 1914395 to another, etc, ensuring at least 3 reactions.

We need to construct JSON tree: root is molecule (target). Its child is reaction using template 1914393, whose children are precursor molecules (type mol). Then for each precursor that is not commercially available maybe we need further reactions using next templates.

We need to ensure route has at least 3 reactions, using those templates in order. So likely chain: target -> reaction1 (1914393) -> gives two fragments: fragment A and fragment B. Then apply 1914394 to fragment A (or B) to further break, then apply 1914395 to resulting fragment.

We need to get the actual precursors from applying templates. Use apply_template tool.
